title: A Tensor-Algebraic No-Go Theorem for High-Dimensional Photonic Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger States Discovered with AlphaProof Nexus
abstract: arXiv:2611.26300v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Photonic GHZ states generated with probabilistic pair sources can be described by edge-coloured, complex-weighted graphs. In this representation, conditioning on an event with one photon in every detector turns the output amplitudes into coherent sums over perfect matchings, and generating an \(N\)-photon \(D\)-dimensional GHZ state is equivalent to constructing a monochromatic quantum graph. Here, we prove that no complex-weighted monochromatic quantum graph exists for any even \(N\ge4\) when \(D\ge N\). The proof, discovered through AI-assisted formal proof search in Lean using AlphaProof Nexus, constructs a weighted sum \(\mathcal F\) of amplitudes whose coefficients factor vertex by vertex. Summing over the colours at one fixed vertex reduces the problem to an \((N-1)\times N\) matrix of effective edge weights. For the graph amplitudes \(\omega\) and GHZ target \(\Delta\), the row--column imbalance yields \(\mathcal F(\omega)=0\) b

translated_title: 利用AlphaProof Nexus发现的高维光子Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger态的张量代数不可行定理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.26300v1 公告类型：交叉（cross）摘要：由概率性双光子对光源产生的光子GHZ态可以用边着色、复数加权的图来描述。在这种表示中，以“每个探测器恰好有一个光子”的事件为条件，输出振幅变为完美匹配上的相干叠加和，而生成N光子D维GHZ态则等价于构造一个单色量子图。本文证明：当D≥N时，对于任何偶数N≥4，不存在复数加权的单色量子图。该证明通过AlphaProof Nexus在Lean中进行AI辅助形式化证明搜索而发现，其构造了一个系数可逐顶点因子化的振幅加权和𝓕。在某个固定顶点处对各颜色求和后，问题被约化为有效边权构成的(N-1)×N矩阵。对于图振幅ω与GHZ目标态Δ，行列数的不平衡导致𝓕(ω)=0……
tldr: 本文利用张量代数方法证明了一个不可行定理：当维数D≥N时，任何偶数N≥4的N光子D维GHZ态都无法通过概率性对光源对应的单色量子图实现，且该证明由AlphaProof Nexus通过AI辅助形式化证明搜索在Lean中完成。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a tensor-algebraic no-go theorem—that no complex-weighted monochromatic quantum graph can realize N-photon D-dimensional GHZ states for any even N≥4 when D≥N—with the proof discovered through AI-assisted formal proof search using AlphaProof Nexus in Lean.
